title: Private Dentistry Awards 2026: the winners!
html:
The Private Dentistry Awards 2026 celebrated the individuals, teams and practices raising standards across private dentistry – discover this year’s winners below.

On Friday 20 November 2026, the UK’s private dental sector gathered at the JW Marriott Grosvenor House London for the Private Dentistry Awards 2026.

Held in the hotel’s Great Room, the evening brought together finalists, judges, sponsors and guests to recognise outstanding achievement across the profession. The celebrations included a drinks reception, three-course dinner, awards ceremony and evening entertainment.

Now in their 25th year, the Private Dentistry Awards celebrate excellence across the UK’s private dental sector. This year’s awards received more than 1,000 entries across 16 categories, highlighting the commitment, innovation and high standards demonstrated by dental professionals, teams and practices nationwide.

A panel of 40 judges, chaired by Dr James Goolnik of Optimal Dental Health, had the tough job of choosing the winners from a world-class field of entries.

Congratulations to every winner, highly commended entrant and finalist. Being shortlisted is a massive achievement in itself, and this year’s winners have demonstrated an exceptional commitment to patient care, clinical standards, innovation and practice leadership.
